phase_name: Technical Debt and Architectural Polish (Improvement Notes)

remaining_tasks.name: Manual verification of breaking changes (Medicpack → inventory)

human_actions_pending.context: Medicpack no longer heals instantly — it adds a HealthItem to inventory. Player must verify consume flow works end-to-end.

decisions.decision: HitboxComponent emits hit_taken(attack) signal instead of calling health_component.damage() via @export
decisions.rationale: Remove tight coupling so component is reusable without HealthComponent

decisions.decision: HealthComponent emits health_changed(current, max) signal instead of calling health_bar.update() via @export
decisions.rationale: UI decoupling — HealthComponent should not know about HealthBar nodes

decisions.decision: SpawnerComponent created as reusable component; abandoned_village.gd and lake_world.gd refactored to use it
decisions.rationale: Identical copy-paste spawning logic in both world scripts

decisions.decision: Item identity already uses .id comparison in inventory.gd — audit only
InventoryUI gets grab_focus() on first slot + _unhandled_input for Tab/I close (Phase 13 pattern)
decisions.rationale: Consistency with campfire menu keyboard nav

decisions.decision: Collection feedback = gold flash modulate ~0.4s on receiving InventorySlotUI
decisions.rationale: Visible but non-intrusive feedback matching HUD strip gold color

decisions.decision: Hover tooltips use Godot built-in tooltip_text on slot buttons
decisions.rationale: Zero custom UI needed; Godot handles positioning and display

decisions.decision: Convert _process polling to _unhandled_input in collectable.gd and medicpack.gd
decisions.rationale: Same pattern as Phase 13 campfire; removes per-frame Input polling

decisions.decision: Replace assert() in collectable.gd with push_warning() + early return
decisions.rationale: assert crashes in release builds; graceful degradation preferred

decisions.decision: Medicpack converts to standard Collectable that adds HealthItem to inventory (breaking change)
decisions.rationale: Roadmap intent: all collectables use uniform pipeline

decisions.decision: State machine fuzzing: MOVE→HIT, HIT→HIT, HIT→DEAD, DEAD invariant tests
decisions.rationale: Complex state transitions identified as coverage gap

decisions.decision: UI integration tests: context menu conditions + keyboard focus (headless-compatible paths only)

next_action: Run /gsd:plan-phase 14 — CONTEXT.md is ready, research + planning is the next step
context_notes: Phase 13 (campfire keyboard nav) fully shipped and merged (PR #14). Phase 14 discuss completed in --auto mode. All 12 decisions are documented in 14-CONTEXT.md. No blockers. Ready to plan immediately.
